description: This Java source file defines an ObsValidator class within the OpenMRS API project. It implements validation logic for the Obs class, including checks for required fields, value consistency, reference ranges, and hierarchical structure validation. The file also manages reference range calculations and interpretation settings for observations.

classes.name: ObsValidator
classes.description: A class implementing the Validator interface to validate Obs objects. It performs comprehensive validation including field null checks, type and range validations, reference range evaluations, hierarchical consistency checks, and interpretation setting based on values.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks whether the given class is assignable from Obs, indicating support for validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Main method that validates an Obs object, rejecting nulls and voided instances, and calling helper methods for detailed validation.

methods.name: validateHelper
methods.description: Recursively validates an Obs and its nested group members, ensuring required fields are set, hierarchical integrity, and concept/datatype-specific validation.

methods.name: validateConceptReferenceRange
methods.description: Validates numeric ranges and sets reference range and interpretation for an Obs.

methods.name: getReferenceRange
methods.description: Retrieves the most appropriate reference range for a numeric concept in an Obs, considering all applicable ranges and defaults.

methods.name: getDefaultReferenceRange
methods.description: Returns default reference range from a ConceptNumeric when no specific ranges are defined.

methods.name: findStrictestReferenceRange
methods.description: Determines the most restrictive reference range from a list of valid ranges by comparing boundaries.

methods.name: validateAbsoluteRanges
methods.description: Checks if the Obs' numeric value is within the specified high and low absolute reference bounds.

methods.name: setObsReferenceRange
methods.description: Creates and assigns an ObsReferenceRange object to an Obs, based on provided ConceptReferenceRange or ConceptNumeric.

methods.name: setObsInterpretation
methods.description: Sets the interpretation (e.g., HIGH, LOW, NORMAL) for an Obs based on its reference range and value.
